spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** The in most celestial good is like a great and noble principle whose interior goods and truths of wisdom have been seized and carried away. It descended through all the degrees of the mind to recover what belonged to it. In the same way the Lord 's celest ial good descended from the in most states toward the tru ths born from it, so that it might lib erate them and gather back the wisdom that had been scattered and held captive among fals ities and evils.

** ¶2:** It is also like a principle of life whose two faculties — the will and the understanding — have been torn from it by the domin ion of evil . It went forth toward them to redeem them. In the same way the Lord 's celestial good sh ines from the in most states on account of the will and the understanding, which had been separated from conjunction with Him . These are the interior spiritual life existing in two fac ulties, which, considered as to their internal and external operation , become four.

**¶3:** The doctrine that carries souls through states of illumin ation is like a pier cing truth prepared for combat . And the Divine Proceeding within that doctrine is like a wise intelligence that orders and perf ects every truth needed for spiritual warfare against falsities.

**¶4:** The Divine Life that proceeds from the Lord is like a warrior who goes toward a truth born from the Divine that has been taken capt ive by evils, and who liberates it from the power of the falsities that held it.

**¶5:** The Divine Truth sent forth as medi ator is like a great em issary who acts on behalf of the interior goods and truths held among those in capt ivity — namely , the derivative truths and the interior spiritual life within them — so that the living essence of the soul might at last be brought forth from the state of the external mind in which it had been imprisoned.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The First [Man] is like a great distinguished man whose treasure has been taken away from him. He came to pursue his treasure. This is how the [First] Man too came after his sons from the heights, so that he might redeem them and retrieve his treasure, which had been scattered amongst his enemies.

Once again, [he is like a man] whose two sons were taken away from him by [his enemies. He] came out toward them to redeem them. Again, this is how the First Man [too came and] shines in the heights because of his two sons, who were separated from him. They are his living soul that exist in two powers, which makes four.

Once again, the ship [of the day] is like a great spear [that is sharpened and readied for battle. The Great Spirit too, which is in it, is like a wise] [crafts]man who might beautify and set aright [all] the armour for war.
Once again, the Living Spirit is like a combatant who might go towards a king's son who has been taken prisoner of war, and he redeems him from the hands of his enemies.

[The Amba]ssador too is like a great man [who went forth] because of the treasure [that is in the] hand of his prisoners [, to retrieve] these light powers [, that is, the] sons and their soul, so that they would [be set free and (the soul) might] be brought forth in the land wherein it was imprisoned.
